d: After Holly and Abby get into an argument, Holly goes behind Abby's back to work with a huge star  Maddie prepares for another Hollywood job  the girls are on edge when Abby announces an open call audition in Los Angeles.

The mothers' patience with Abby grows thin during the ALDC's last week in Los Angeles  Abby brings in two swing dancers that threaten the other girls' chances at an audition  Abby's job as a manager is put to the test.

While in Los Angeles, the girls juggle a competition and a music video shoot  Abby attempts to shut down the music video shoot  the mothers fight to keep their daughters on the team when Abby announces that she will be cutting one dancer.

The ALDC returns to Pittsburgh  the mothers are divided based on who stayed to film the music video and those who left  the group dance becomes a personal attack against the mothers  Abby discovers the team is in the teen division.

The ALDC girls move forward after a rocky journey to Los Angeles  Cathy returns with a surprise choreographer  Abby invites Ashlee and her daughter Brynn to come dance at the ALDC and quickly praises Brynn as "the next Maddie."
The ALDC heads to Philadelphia with a risky non-lyrical routine  Abby gives Nia an ultimatum  frustrated with the lack of support from Melissa and Jill, Holly makes friends with two unlikely allies.

The ALDC arrives in Los Angeles  a top West Coast dance studio declares war on the ALDC  Abby sets up an audition for the girls with a casting agent  Abby suffers a breakdown, causing the mothers to question her abilities as a manager.
